parent_objective: synthesize controlled-fusion evidence after exact-compatible candidates and rejected-branch retune both fail promotion-level overlap
blocked_by: M951 used the one allowed local retune and still produced zero candidate alphas
invalidates: additional local coefficient tweaks on the same controlled-fusion objective before synthesis

public_gates: M952 must list supported and falsified claims
M952 must decide whether to stop, pivot, or open a new branch
M952 must block training, replay, PPO, and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run another local retune
do not open encoders or GRU without an explicit synthesis decision

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_synthesis: synthesize controlled-fusion candidate, replay, rejected-branch, and retune evidence
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: decides the next branch after controlled-fusion exact candidates fail replay and rejected-branch retune fails exact/preflight overlap
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: branch synthesis only; no training, replay, PPO, driver improvement claim, or promotion
stop_condition: stop if supported claims are omitted
stop if falsified claims are omitted
stop if next branch decision is omitted
stop if training, replay, PPO, or promotion is attempted
fallback_plan: if controlled-fusion local objectives are exhausted, pivot to a new branch
if trajectory-target export is chosen, pre-register it as a new branch
if a wider trainable surface is chosen, justify it with synthesis evidence first
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M951 completes the one bounded retune admitted by M950 and still has zero candidate alphas

hypothesis: The controlled-fusion local objective branch has enough evidence to decide whether to stop local retuning and pivot to a new branch.
success_criteria: supported and falsified claims are recorded
training, replay, PPO, and promotion are blocked
failure_criteria: M952 admits another local retune without synthesis
M952 runs training, full replay, PPO, or promotion
M952 does not choose the next blocker
decision_rule: M952 may only synthesize the branch and select the next blocker. It must not train, run replay, run PPO, or promote.
next_blocker: controlled-fusion branch needs synthesis before any further local objective change
